posts.text: Let me tell you about the best day of my life. Instead of a normal recap, here's a breakdown of what really it took to put on Product Design Sprint 2026, a the nation's biggest product design competition. Over the course of 10 months and 20 days, of planning, solving and pushing our team, seeing the fruition of our ambition on March 21st 2026, became the best of my life (yet). Back to PDS25, our budget was cut, workshops were forgotten and team morale seemed to dissipate. But, I had a plan and i

After a year of planning, calls and meetings, I'm excited to announce... I'm hosting a Designathon!! 😸😸 If you're a professional in design or product we'd love to have you as a judge or mentor (send over a DM!). This year's PDS has more merch, prizes, food and sponsors than ever before, even if you've never designed before, PDS is a place for everyone (no suits required)🧩💜. Let me know if you have any questions and apply before we're full!🤞🤞 https://luma.com/uf48lyvh
I'm beyond excited to join Stush Foods this summer. A special thank you to Opal Rowe for welcoming me with open arms. Looking forward to doing great things at Stush!
